_about: Public-domain Moses Lowman (1680-1752), Presbyterian minister at Clapham, for the Word Hoard: A Paraphrase and Notes on the Revelation of St John (1745), A Dissertation on the Civil Government of the Hebrews (1740) and A Rational of the Ritual of the Hebrew Worship (1748), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 46 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
